description: Configuration for running dbt models via Cosmos.

dbt_project_name.description: Name of the dbt project folder under include/dbt/ (contains dbt_project.yml and profiles.yml), e.g. moon_analytics.
dbt_project_name.title: dbt project name

select.description: dbt node selector (e.g. 'tag:daily', 'staging.*', 'fct_spacecraft_outcomes+'). Leave empty to run all models.
select.title: Select

full_refresh.description: Run with --full-refresh (rebuilds all models from scratch)
full_refresh.title: Full Refresh

result_table.description: DuckDB table (dbt model) to query for the final result
result_table.title: Result Table

target_variable.description: Airflow Variable name to store the dbt results in
target_variable.title: Target Variable

title: Run dbt project with Cosmos
